summary: Frontend-only verification of iMessage-style What's Next chat game and Edit-profile / settings / instrum toolbar changes on the public preview URL. All major flows and acceptance criteria from the review request pass.
tests_executed: Game hub loads with data-testid=game-hero-lyrics; startGame(firstEligibleSongId) opens data-testid=game-fullscreen with game-chat/game-thread/game-artist-avatar/game-artist-name/game-score/game-round (0 pts, 1/5).
Intro flow: state.game.phase goes to 'intro'; two artist bubbles (game-msg-artist-*) with DIFFERENT text render; Round divider shown; compose input becomes editable afterwards.
Wrong answer x2: me bubble + emoji reply + game-try-chip after 1st wrong; result-note + Next line button (game-next) after 2nd wrong.
Correct answer: score jumped from 10 -> 110 (+100), streak=1, emoji reply bubble added.

Chat style: default (no localStorage) data-wct=glass/data-wcf=glass/data-glow=1/data-ts=m on [data-game-root]. Switching to Neon sets data-wct=neon. Glow Max sets data-glow=2. Text size Large sets data-ts=l. localStorage treesh_wn_style persists {theme:'neon',glow:'2',ts:'l'}.

Hints: game-hints-tray shows balance '200 Starlites'. All five hint buttons present (longer/first/peek/letters/pick). game-hint-freeze correctly ABSENT when timer mode off. First word deducted 10 (200->190), added game-hint-note-*, prefilled input with first word 'I '. Pick-from-3 rendered game-pick-card-* with 3 options.
Round selection (wcPickTargets): tested across all 37 eligible songs — 0 duplicate-window violations and 0 min-gap<4 violations.
Back button game-close-button closes game: game-fullscreen removed, state.game=null.
history.back() during a game closes the game and page view stays on #/game.
Keyboard simulation: overriding visualViewport.height=420, offsetTop=180 and calling _wnVV() sets [data-game-root] style top=180px, height=420px and adds class is-kb.
Edit profile GUEST (/_sbtest.html): pf-guest-account-top present ABOVE #set-nick in DOM order; pf-acct-signup + pf-acct-signin visible; #set-uname absent.

Edit profile SIGNED IN (a@test.com/secret123): #set-uname present; settings-email-value shows 'a@test.com'; settings-change-email opens change-email sheet; settings-change-password opens password sheet; pf-guest-account-top absent; duplicate pf-acct-email / pf-acct-password rows absent.
Settings tabs bar: inactive buttons boxShadow 'rgba(0,0,0,0.14) 0px 1px 2px 0px' (soft, not the heavy old 0px 4px 18px); active button uses subtle inset+accent glow.
Instrum toolbar: at #/instrum after scroll, .ixp-tp top=84, header .topbar-surface bottom=78 → gap exactly 6px.
test_credentials: Mock Supabase on /_sbtest.html only: a@test.com / secret123 (seed __mock_sb_db as per /app/memory/test_credentials.md).
seed_data_creation: localStorage treesh_whatsnew_off=true, treesh_profile={nickname:'Tester',birthday:'2000-01-01'}, __mock_sb_db seeded for signed-in profile test. Did NOT sign up on real index.html.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 15 acceptance checks from iteration_22 request passed on https://treesh-phase5.preview.emergentagent.com. Theme data attributes live on [data-game-root] (not document.documentElement); check there for data-wct/data-wcf/data-glow/data-ts. Hints tray auto-closes after using a hint — re-open with game-hints-button to verify a hint shows 'Used' in subsequent rounds. gameEligibleSongs() returned 37 songs; wcPickTargets windows were all valid.
